verdict.rationale: Orb documents automatic payment retry logic (1/4/9 days) and invoice issuance rules (auto vs. manual approval), which cover grace periods and part of the final-state rule concept, but there is no evidence of branded dunning emails, in-app banners, or explicit cancel-vs-unpaid end-state configuration. missing for 10: branded email templates/customization, in-app banner support, explicit cancel-vs-unpaid final state rules, and any UI/workflow for configuring a full dunning sequence beyond payment retries.
